subject.title: feat(sessions): add session.allowMainDelete to permit main-session deletion

question: Should OpenClaw expose true deletion of the canonical main-session entry as a supported configuration mode when `sessions.reset` already provides the documented reset path?
rationale: The proposed behavior is not an established bug fix: it adds a persistent destructive-state option with semantics distinct from, but overlapping, the current reset contract. Maintainers need to decide whether that distinction is a supported product contract before implementation work can be evaluated.

options.title: Keep reset canonical
options.body: Decline the parallel delete setting and direct reset/cleanup callers to the existing `sessions.reset` contract.

options.title: Sponsor distinct deletion semantics
options.body: Define why a missing main-session entry is required beyond reset, then rebase the design with explicit lifecycle, docs, and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Keep reset canonical
recommendation.body: Decline the parallel delete setting and direct reset/cleanup callers to the existing `sessions.reset` contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session-handler refactoring places this person closest to the current gateway ownership boundary.
